syn: cp [OPTION]... [-T] SOURCE DEST ⏎ cp [OPTION]... SOURCE... DIRECTORY ⏎ cp [OPTION]... -t DIRECTORY SOURCE...

p.es: Dónde se copia: un archivo nuevo, o un directorio existente si hay varios orígenes.
p.en: Where it is copied: a new file, or an existing directory when there are several sources.

o.es: Copia directorios con todo su contenido.
o.en: Copy directories with all their contents.

o.es: Copia «de archivo»: recursivo y conserva permisos, propietario, fechas y enlaces (= -dR --preserve=all).
o.en: "Archive" copy: recursive and preserves permissions, owner, timestamps and links (= -dR --preserve=all).
Prompt before overwriting.

o.es: Si no se puede abrir el destino, lo borra e inténtalo de nuevo.
o.en: If the destination cannot be opened, remove it and try again.

o.es: No sobrescribe archivos que ya existan.
o.en: Do not overwrite an existing file.

o.es: Copia solo si el origen es más nuevo que el destino o este no existe.
o.en: Copy only when the source is newer than the destination or the destination is missing.
Explain what is being done.
Preserve mode, ownership and timestamps.

o.es: En vez de copiar, crea enlaces duros.
o.en: Hard-link files instead of copying.

o.es: En vez de copiar, crea enlaces simbólicos.
o.en: Make symbolic links instead of copying.

o.es: Copia todo dentro del directorio DIR (el destino va antes que los orígenes).
o.en: Copy everything into DIR (destination given before the sources).

o.es: Trata el destino siempre como archivo, no como directorio.
o.en: Always treat the destination as a file, not a directory.

o.es: Hace copia de seguridad de cada archivo destino que se sobrescriba.
o.en: Make a backup of each existing destination file.

o.es: Conserva los atributos indicados (mode, ownership, timestamps, links, all…).
o.en: Preserve the listed attributes (mode, ownership, timestamps, links, all…).

o.es: Usa la ruta completa del origen bajo el directorio destino.
o.en: Use the full source path under the destination directory.

o.es: Copia «ligera» (copy-on-write) en sistemas que la admiten.
o.en: Lightweight copy-on-write on supporting filesystems.
don't copy the file data, just the attributes
like --backup but does not accept an argument
copy contents of special files when recursive
same as --no-dereference --preserve=links
explain how a file is copied. Implies -v
follow command-line symbolic links in SOURCE
always follow symbolic links in SOURCE
never follow symbolic links in SOURCE
follow existing symlinks to directories
don't preserve the specified attributes
remove each existing destination file before attempting to open it (contrast with --force)
control creation of sparse files. See below
remove any trailing slashes from each SOURCE argument
override the usual backup suffix
stay on this file system
set SELinux security context of destination file to default type
like -Z, or if CTX is specified then set the SELinux or SMACK security context to CTX
display this help and exit
output version information and exit
